Inspect and reset drt's durable state (watermarks, run state, mirror keys).

## Usage

```bash
drt state [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`reset`](state-reset.md) | Reset one sync's state. |
| [`show`](state-show.md) | Show stored watermark and last-run state. |
